code.originalText: Eight-week review: blood pressure at home and in the clinic, potassium and kidney function, lipids, KCCQ-12 and drug coverage

text.paragraph: Eight-week review: blood pressure, potassium, lipids and heart failure. [S]

Ms. Hurston returns eight weeks after spironolactone was added and two weeks after her sick visit for lightheadedness in the heat. She restarted chlorthalidone, spironolactone and dapagliflozin after two days, as planned; the lightheadedness has not returned since she moved her gardening to the early morning and drinks water through the day, and the energy assistance application for cooling help is in. She did not have the metabolic panel one to two weeks after starting spironolactone: the bus route to the laboratory changed, and she had no ride. Her home blood pressure average this week is 124/74, and she has no breathlessness on the stairs at school. Extra Help and the Medicare Savings Program were approved, and the SHINE counselor helped her choose a drug plan that begins next month. [S]

The panel due one to two weeks after spironolactone was started was missed: the bus route to the laboratory changed and she had no ride. The first check came at the sick visit six weeks after the start: potassium 4.4 mmol/L, with creatinine 1.10 mg/dL from volume depletion in the heat, not from the potassium. No harm from the missed check is evident: no hyperkalemia at six weeks or today. Corrective action: laboratory tests on clinic visit days where possible, and rides through the county's transportation program for any separate trip

text.paragraph: Guideline basis: 2025 AHA/ACC/AANP/AAPA/ABC/ACCP/ACPM/AGS/AMA/ASPC/NMA/PCNA/SGIM Guideline for the Prevention, Detection, Evaluation and Management of High Blood Pressure in Adults (2025); 2022 AHA/ACC/HFSA Guideline for the Management of Heart Failure (2022); CMID: Clinical Monitoring Intelligence Database, hypertension and heart failure monographs (2026); Signs and Symptoms of Stroke (2026); Help with drug costs (Extra Help) (2026); Medicare Savings Programs (2026); Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program (LIHEAP) (2026)

Follow-up: Annual wellness visit in about three months. Heart failure and blood pressure review in about four months with a metabolic panel and the KCCQ-12. Call for lightheadedness or a weight change beyond the plan; call 911 for any BE FAST sign. Next scheduled visit 1958-09-14: subsequent annual wellness visit. [S]
